    How this plan was checked

    Original recordsFresh account pulls, 2025 product sales files, 14-day variation data by ad type, deal sheet, SKU lists, inventory.
    Independent rebuildNew code recomputes units, price, break-even, cap, TACoS, budget and split for every product.
    Second sourceAds console: spend per product, growth stages and bands, deal dates.
    Compared cell by cellEvery number in the plan, with a tolerance, plus the rules and the wording.
    Fixed and re-runWording errors fixed, fee correction applied, re-run until no mismatch.
